object.description: Setup: notification permission granted. Steps: 1. Start a session, press the device Home button, select Finish in the notification and open the app. 2. Start a session, press Back until the Home screen shows, open the notification shade and select Finish. Expected: In step 1 the Summary screen for the session shows when the app opens. In step 2 the Summary screen for the session shows within 2 s of closing the shade.
